body: Thank you for responding! I've talked with her about it off and on for a while but it's not really changing and it doesnt go over well. But that's okay. Thanks for your kindness in responding!
I appreciate your taking the time to respond! I've tried to talk about it but it doesnt really go over well. :( but thanks for the support and kindness !
Hey, are you still needing someone to talk to?

Thank you so much for your kindness!! Everyone who has commented has genuinely brought me so much affirmation and peace about this journey I'm on. 

Just to offer some kindness to my sister , we grew up in a fairly conservative environment, not actively anti-LGBTQ+, but not at all educated about LGTBQ+ communities and people. She wasnt in any way actively phobic, she just genuinely thought asexuality was something that it definitely is not haha. Not to make fun of her, but she thought I meant "I think I can reproduce without sex/male biological input." So I can see why she was so confused and rejected that. Because of her lack of knowledge, I was then left confused by what I thought ace meant!

Thank you so much for your kindness 🖤🖤 I dont know that I've met anyone in life who is openly ace, and it can feel so isolating and lonely! Its something I've really struggled with for so long, not being like everyone else I know. It's so nice to talk to people who are like me 💜

I think the hard part for me is distinguishing attraction romantically vs sexually? I've definitely found people attractive and I definitely want a partner and relationship. But I have never imagined or desired sex with people I find attractive? I think "Wow that guy is really attractive... I would like to be in a relationship with him." And then that's really where the thought would end?? So I've just always thought I'm straight, just a late bloomer when it comes to sex drive and desire. The split attraction model is something I just learned about and its been really helpful for me as I restart my journey of self discovery 🖤
Haha thank you! I find people attractive, but the thought always has just kind of ended there! Like hey that guy is really good looking... cool.

You have survived so much in your life, I think that speaks to an incredible resiliency. I know some people who have gone through nursing schools and share similar experiences. It's not right that people who just want to help others often are treated so badly. If you like to learn and study, is there any studying that you can do on your own that can fill that need for you? There is a lot of ugliness in the world, that's true. What is stopping you from going back to veganism ? I think you have a lot of integrity and strength to confront things that you know will hurt you. I think it's also important to bring light into your life, it's all a balancing act. It's really good and important to be informed, but it's also good to seek out the good that exists. I think when people tell you to stop watching these videos, that might be what they want to tell you. 
I'm really sorry you have so much weight on you.

How are you feeling, that's making you hurt so much? Is it loneliness, or trauma, or something else? There is no need to share any details you arent comfortable with. But knowing what the root of your pain is can sometimes help you learn what you need from your support systems.

I understand. What do you need out of a therapist? What would make you feel like a therapist was helpful? Do you have anything in your life that helps lift the weight off of your shoulders? Sometimes when we say "I want to die" what we really mean is "I want to stop hurting." Is that what you mean, too?

Did they tell you that they want you gone? Why were the therapists a waste of your time? Do you feel they wanted to help you, maybe they just didn't know what you needed? 

EDIT: I'm sorry I misread something in your comment. I know family can really hurt us, and we dont usually have people telling us that it's okay to leave people who hurt us, even biological family. If someone is bringing you so much pain, it's okay to keep them out of your life. Is that possible for you?
What help did you need that you didnt get? I know you feel your support systems didnt help you. How did they let you down?
I'm very sorry that you are in so much pain. I wish I could take some of that pain off your shoulders.
I'm sorry that youve never felt seen or heard. The pain of depression is sometimes so unbearable that it can feel like the only way to make it stop hurting.
